description: Lac de la Moubra is the small lake on the Crans-Montana plateau, and this frame is the shore promenade, with firs and tawny late-September grass around still water. It is not the southward alpine panorama already published, and the night shore has no swimmers. The Open-Meteo model is overcast and cool, about 11°C, with a light wind and no precipitation, and the sun is below the horizon.
